body:
I dropped previous formats as we always download `latest` anyway and I suppose they won't change back to a previous format again.

We could re-add those if we want to add support for specifying the desired SDK version to download.

BTW, since the version is part of the `.app` name now, we could drop the `jq` requirement and just extract it from there.
